semiconductor_relevance: High — Zhejiang CrystalYond Semiconductor is a key supplier of high-quality silicon carbide substrates, which are critical for advanced semiconductor applications.
summary: Zhejiang CrystalYond Semiconductor Co., Ltd specializes in the production of high-quality silicon carbide (SiC) substrates, focusing on 8- and 12-inch wafers with low dislocation densities. The company is committed to setting global quality standards for third-generation semiconductor materials, with significant investment in R&D to enhance substrate quality and reduce manufacturing costs.
capabilities: Production of 8- and 12-inch silicon carbide (SiC) substrates
Baseline dislocation density (BPD) of less than 10
Edge dislocation density (EPD) of less than 1000
Advanced production management and leading-edge equipment for mass production
